about: Every lamp-post, as data (docs/design/ARPG.md section 2 'Lamp-posts', 7.2 Death), read by logic/Content/LampPosts.cs. The one source of truth for where posts stand and what they give: Lamps v2's board points (Lamps.Posts) are this list's board posts. kind: 'checkpoint' (lit by her hand, a world fact, never reset; her rise point and a waypoint; no board point), 'dark' (an act's dark post off the road: relit for a lamp-board point, LampBook.RelightPost; also a rise point). town: a town's post, lit from the start. door: it stands at a boss's door. board: true only for dark posts. light: the zone light that is its lantern (-1: none); dark until lit. draft: where it stands is still a placeholder. rise: (M5 r3) the road's way from it [x, z]: she rises 1.75 m off the post that way (LampRise.RiseSpot; the M5 lead's read of the road beside each post, the ground lead to confirm).

lit.about: (M5 r2) A lit post's lantern against her ember pool: color (cooler, whiter gold), level (its brightness over the zone light as built), flare (the level it kindles at, falling to level over flareSeconds). Functional; L1 owns the final light.

moved.about: PROVISIONAL: the ground lead moves this onto pocket 2's real ground and sets the light index when it places the lamp

posts.name: The lamp at the wood's edge
